reason: B is the better prospective proposal because it specifies a distinct, testable oxide-dispersion intervention with physically plausible high-temperature strengthening and irradiation-defect-sink mechanisms. A more directly targets the W–Ta–Cr–V limitation, but its cited work already produced and demonstrated the thermal/irradiation behavior of the same Hf-containing quinary alloy, so it largely repeats prior work rather than proposing a new contribution.
